voices.label: 轻柔美式女声
voices.description: 声音轻柔，适合安静时精听。

voices.label: 清晰美式女声
voices.description: 表达明晰，适合日常听写与跟读。

voices.label: 沉稳美式男声
voices.description: 男声示范，帮助熟悉不同音色。

voices.label: 英式女声
voices.description: 英式发音，适合与美式声线对照听。

clips.title: 见面打招呼
clips.text: Hello, my name is Anna. I am happy to meet you. What is your name?
clips.translation: 你好，我叫安娜。很高兴见到你。你叫什么名字？
clips.focus: 听清姓名和问候，留意问句的语调。

clips.title: 请对方慢一点
clips.text: Please speak slowly. I am learning English. Can you say that again, please? Thank you.
clips.translation: 请说慢一点。我正在学英语。请你再说一遍，好吗？谢谢。
clips.focus: 练习 please、slowly 和 again 的重音。

clips.title: 表达简单需要
clips.text: I need some water, please. My cup is on the table. This one is mine.
clips.translation: 请给我一些水。我的杯子在桌上。这一个是我的。
clips.focus: 听清 need、cup 和 mine，分辨指代。

clips.title: 约好见面时间
clips.text: Today is Monday. The class starts at nine. See you at the door. Have a good day.
clips.translation: 今天是星期一。九点开始上课。门口见。祝你今天愉快。
clips.focus: 听清星期、时间和见面地点。

clips.title: 在咖啡馆点单
clips.text: Could I have a small coffee and a sandwich, please? I would like to sit by the window.
clips.translation: 请给我一杯小杯咖啡和一个三明治，好吗？我想坐在窗边。
clips.focus: 听清 small 与 by the window，模仿礼貌请求。

clips.title: 找到图书馆
clips.text: The library is next to the bank. Go straight and turn left at the second street. You cannot miss it.
clips.translation: 图书馆就在银行旁边。直走，在第二条街左转。很容易找到。
clips.focus: 听清 next to、straight 和 second，按顺序理解指路。

clips.title: 描述一天的安排
clips.text: I usually get up at seven and walk to school. After class, I do my homework and call my family.
clips.translation: 我通常七点起床，步行去学校。下课后，我做作业，然后给家人打电话。
clips.focus: 留意 usually 与 after，把日常动作连起来。

clips.title: 询问衣服尺码
clips.text: I like this blue shirt, but it is too small. Do you have a larger one in the same colour?
clips.translation: 我喜欢这件蓝衬衫，但它太小了。同样颜色有没有大一点的？
clips.focus: 听清 too small 与 larger，比较不同声线的发音。

clips.title: 确认出行安排
clips.text: Our train leaves in twenty minutes. We have already bought the tickets, but we still need to find the right platform.
clips.translation: 我们的火车二十分钟后发车。票已经买好了，但我们还要找到正确的站台。
clips.focus: 注意 already 和 still 表达的时间关系。

clips.title: 礼貌调整时间
clips.text: I am sorry, but I cannot make it on Friday. Could we meet on Saturday morning instead? That would be much easier for me.
clips.translation: 抱歉，我周五来不了。我们改成周六上午见面可以吗？那样我会方便得多。
clips.focus: 理解 make it 和 instead，跟读委婉的语气。

clips.title: 描述遗失的物品
clips.text: I think I left my bag on the bus. It is a small black bag with a book and a pair of glasses inside.
clips.translation: 我想我把包落在公交车上了。那是一个黑色小包，里面有一本书和一副眼镜。
clips.focus: 提取颜色、大小和物品等关键信息。

clips.title: 分享周末经历
clips.text: We planned to go hiking, but it started raining. We stayed at home and cooked together instead. It was still a lovely afternoon.
clips.translation: 我们本来打算去徒步，但下起了雨。于是我们待在家里一起做饭。那个下午依然很愉快。
clips.focus: 听清计划改变的原因与结果。

clips.title: 表达不同意见
clips.text: I understand why you prefer studying alone. Personally, I learn more when I discuss ideas with other people, as long as everyone has prepared in advance.
clips.translation: 我理解你为什么更喜欢独自学习。就我而言，只要大家事先做了准备，和别人讨论想法能让我学到更多。
clips.focus: 用理解对方、表达观点、补充条件的顺序组织口语。

clips.title: 解释设备问题
clips.text: The internet connection keeps dropping during my online classes. I have restarted the router twice, but the problem continues. Could someone check it this afternoon?
clips.translation: 我上网课时网络总是断开。我已经重启路由器两次了，但问题还在。今天下午能有人来检查一下吗？
clips.focus: 依次说明问题、已经尝试的办法和希望得到的帮助。

clips.title: 复述小组决定
clips.text: To sum up, we agreed to divide the work into three parts. Everyone will share a first draft by Thursday, and we will review the whole report together on Friday.
clips.translation: 总结一下，我们决定把工作分成三部分。大家会在周四前提交初稿，周五再一起审阅整份报告。
clips.focus: 提取分工、截止时间和后续安排。

clips.title: 确认自己理解正确
clips.text: Let me check that I understood you correctly. You would like a shorter introduction, but you want us to keep the examples. Is that what you meant?
clips.translation: 让我确认一下自己的理解是否正确。你希望引言短一些，但想保留例子。你是这个意思吗？
clips.focus: 模仿确认理解的语气，区分对方的两项要求。

clips.title: 区分结果与原因
clips.text: The results suggest a connection between sleep and memory, but they do not prove that one directly causes the other. We should consider other possible explanations before drawing a conclusion.
clips.translation: 结果显示睡眠和记忆之间存在联系，但不能证明两者具有直接因果关系。得出结论前，我们还应考虑其他可能的解释。
clips.focus: 听清 suggest、prove 和 before 对证据强度的限定。

clips.title: 提出具体修改建议
clips.text: Your main argument is clear, and the examples are relevant. The transition between the second and third sections could be smoother. A sentence explaining how the ideas connect would help the reader.
clips.translation: 你的主要论点很清楚，例子也切题。第二和第三部分的衔接还可以更顺畅。加一句解释两部分联系的话，会更方便读者理解。
clips.focus: 听辨肯定、问题和可执行建议。

clips.title: 协商可行的安排
clips.text: I can finish the analysis by Wednesday, provided that the data arrives on time. If there is another delay, we may need to reduce the scope rather than rush the final checks.
clips.translation: 如果数据按时到达，我可以在周三前完成分析。如果再次延迟，我们可能需要缩小范围，而不能仓促完成最后的检查。
clips.focus: 理解 provided that 引出的条件，注意两种方案的对照。

clips.title: 承认优点并指出限制
clips.text: Online courses offer flexibility, especially for people who work full time. However, flexibility alone does not guarantee effective learning. Learners also need useful feedback and regular opportunities to practise.
clips.translation: 网络课程提供了灵活性，对全职工作的人尤其如此。不过，仅有灵活性并不能保证学习有效。学习者还需要有用的反馈和经常练习的机会。
clips.focus: 听清转折后的核心观点，留意 especially 与 alone 的作用。

clips.title: 审慎解释研究发现
clips.text: Although the intervention produced a measurable improvement, the findings should be interpreted cautiously. The sample was small, and the absence of a comparison group makes it difficult to rule out alternative explanations.
clips.translation: 尽管这项干预带来了可测量的改善，仍应谨慎解释研究结果。样本较小，而且缺乏对照组，因此很难排除其他解释。
clips.focus: 跟随让步、结论限定和方法局限之间的逻辑关系。

clips.title: 综合不同研究观点
clips.text: These accounts are not necessarily contradictory. One describes the conditions under which learning occurs, whereas the other explains the processes involved. A useful synthesis would distinguish between these levels of explanation.
clips.translation: 这些解释未必相互矛盾。一种描述学习发生的条件，另一种解释其中涉及的过程。要有效整合两者，应区分这些不同的解释层次。
clips.focus: 听辨 whereas 的对照，理解 conditions 与 processes 的区别。

clips.title: 在研讨课上追问
clips.text: Could you clarify the assumption underlying that interpretation? If the participants had different levels of prior knowledge, the observed difference might reflect their starting points rather than the effectiveness of the teaching method.
clips.translation: 你能说明这种解释背后的假设吗？如果参与者的先备知识不同，观察到的差异可能反映的是他们的起点，而不是教学方法的有效性。
clips.focus: 注意假设条件、可能性措辞及替代解释。

clips.title: 从证据谈到实践
clips.text: The practical implication is not that a single approach should replace all others. Rather, teachers need to adapt their choices to the task, monitor learners' responses, and revise their decisions as new evidence emerges.
clips.translation: 实际启示并不是用某一种方法取代其他所有方法。教师需要根据任务调整选择，观察学习者的反应，并随着新证据出现修正决定。
clips.focus: 抓住不是全面替代、而是持续调整这一论点。
